name: NG exhaustion chain discovery freeze
gate: Do not begin chain discovery until required Target 1 causal validation and Target 2 endpoint-relative aftermath/transition validation are complete.
measurement_origin: For each NG trading week, begin at the first actual trade after the Sunday evening weekly reopen and run continuously through the true weekly close.
core_order_of_operations: 1. Find chain instances and chain boundaries first, without assigning any behavioral category.
2. Freeze the discovered chain membership, link order, origin, endpoint/reset point, and censored cases.
3. Only after membership is frozen, calculate and inspect the characteristics of each chain and each link.
4. Only then categorize or name recurring chain types from those observed characteristics.
5. Test whether the posthoc categories replicate on held-out weeks without changing the frozen chain membership rule.
chain_discovery_principle: A chain is an empirically linked lineage of successive exhaustion/tape transitions. Extend a lineage only while information inherited from the earlier chain state measurably improves prediction of the next transition beyond what is explained by the immediately current event alone. When inherited information no longer contributes, mark a reset/new first-order origin. Do not use a pre-named chain type to decide membership.
discovery_unit: ordered adjacent exhaustion links on the complete continuous trading-week stream, including overlaps where a later exhaustion begins before the prior exhaustion has causally confirmed its end

boundary_discovery.preferred_method: sequential predictive-dependence / change-point analysis that can continue an existing lineage, declare a reset, or leave the boundary uncertain/censored rather than force a class
boundary_discovery.origin_information_test: At each successive link, compare prediction using current-link causal information alone versus current-link information plus inherited origin/ancestor state. Chain continuation requires reproducible incremental information from the inherited state; loss of that incremental information is candidate reset evidence.

record_but_do_not_use_to_prelabel_chains: oriented roll20 geometry and decay/reload trajectory
signed price displacement and excursion between links
family/post-state descriptors where causal and frozen
characteristics_not_membership_rules.purpose: These variables describe a chain after the chain instance has been found. They may later reveal natural recurring categories, but they do not create the chain instance in the first pass.

forbidden_first_pass_behavior: No hand-chosen number of links that defines a chain.
No preassigned same-side, reversal, alternating, persistent, collapse, or time-associated chain bucket.
No clustering of chains by their characteristics before chain membership itself is frozen.
No time-of-day or session bucket used to start, end, or assign a chain.
No quantile/tertile/quintile cells used as chain definitions; existing cells are validation diagnostics only.
No fixed number of chain categories selected in advance.

posthoc_characterization.method: Let the frozen chain instances reveal natural groupings in the observed characteristic space; density-based, hierarchical, sequence-pattern, and stability methods are allowed here because membership is already fixed.
posthoc_characterization.naming_rule: Names such as long, short, same-side, reversal, alternating, reload, reset-prone, or time-associated may be applied only after stable characteristic groupings emerge.

time_context.question: After chain instances and behavior categories are frozen, test whether any category is enriched by time-of-day/session position and whether the enrichment replicates.

reveal_holdout_discipline.freeze_before_holdout: sequential inherited-information test, reset logic, uncertainty/censor rules, and all causal feature timing
reveal_holdout_discipline.holdout_membership_use: one-time chain reconstruction with no retuning
reveal_holdout_discipline.posthoc_category_discovery: performed on frozen reveal chain instances after membership is fixed
reveal_holdout_discipline.posthoc_category_holdout_use: one-time replication on frozen holdout chain instances
reveal_holdout_discipline.failed_replication: retain as a negative finding; do not redraw chain boundaries or merge categories to rescue it
